Below you will find a short status update.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Introduce a written status update.
Hieronder is fronted before vind je. Because informal je follows, vind has no added -t; below refers to the written material that follows.
I have summarised the main changes at the top.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Point to the summary at the top.
Heb samengevat is perfect of separable samenvatten. Bovenaan locates the summary at the top; the changes, not the whole document, are what the speaker summarised.
Bovenaan heb ik de belangrijkste wijzigingen samengevat.
I have summarised the main changes at the top.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
S=Dit bericht|V=is|C=ter informatie,|NEG=niet als verzoek om goedkeuring.
This message is for information, not a request for approval.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Clarify the message's purpose.
Ter informatie describes the message's purpose, not an object of is. Niet als verzoek om goedkeuring excludes a request for approval.
Can you put the ticket number in the subject?
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Request a useful subject reference.
Kun precedes je and takes bare infinitive zetten. Het ticketnummer is the item to put in the subject line, not the subject of the sentence.
L=In de eerste alinea|V=staat|S=de gevraagde actie.
The requested action is in the first paragraph.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Locate the action requested in the message.
In de eerste alinea is fronted before staat de gevraagde actie. Staan describes where the action is stated in writing, not an upright posture.
De gevraagde actie staat in de eerste alinea.
The requested action is in the first paragraph.

S=Ik|V=vermeld|G=welke punten nog niet bevestigd zijn.
I mention which points are not yet confirmed.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Mark uncertain points in the update.
Welke punten is an embedded plural subject. Nog niet bevestigd zijn describes points not yet confirmed, with the verb group toward the clause's end.
We will add the missing information later today.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Commit to an update later today.
Zullen is finite with we and takes joined infinitive aanvullen. Later vandaag is the promised time for adding the missing information; this is not completed work.
Later vandaag zullen we de ontbrekende informatie aanvullen.
We will add the missing information later today.

The earlier finish time is no longer current.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Correct an outdated time in writing.
Niet meer means no longer. Actueel describes the earlier finish time as outdated, without supplying a new finish time.
S=Dit overzicht|V=bevat|O=de status van alle openstaande acties.
This overview contains the status of all outstanding actions.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Describe the overview's scope.
Bevat agrees with dit overzicht. Alle openstaande acties specifies the overview's scope; openstaande means outstanding, not already completed.
What information is still missing from my message?
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Ask whether the written update is complete.
Welke informatie is the singular question subject of ontbreekt. Nog asks what remains missing, not just whether the update exists.
Can we discuss this point in a short call?
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Propose a short call for the topic.
Kunnen takes bare infinitive bespreken. In een kort gesprek means a brief call in this remote-work scenario; bespreken takes dit punt directly without over.
Which time suits you this afternoon?
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Ask a colleague for an afternoon time in Belgian Dutch.
Welk tijdstip is the singular question subject of past. Deze namiddag means this afternoon in Belgian usage; voor jou identifies the colleague whose schedule matters.
I have sent the invitation to both teams.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Report the invitation sent to both teams.
Heb verstuurd is perfect with direct object de uitnodiging. Naar beide teams names both recipients; sending does not establish acceptance.
Naar beide teams heb ik de uitnodiging verstuurd.
I have sent the invitation to both teams.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
The user has not accepted the invitation yet.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Distinguish sending from acceptance.
Heeft aanvaard is perfect; aanvaard has no ge- with inseparable aanvaarden. Nog niet denies acceptance so far, even if the invitation has been received.
Can you turn on your microphone for the test?
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Request microphone activation for a test.
Kun takes joined infinitive inschakelen. Voor de test means for the purpose of the test here, rather than a deadline before it.
I can hear you well, but the image is frozen.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Distinguish working audio from frozen video.
Je is the direct object of hoor. Maar joins a second main clause with its own subject het beeld; staat stil describes frozen video while audio works.
We can turn off the camera for this call.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Offer an audio-only option.
Kunnen takes joined infinitive uitschakelen. Voor dit gesprek limits this audio-only option to the particular call, not all future calls.
S=Ik|V=stuur|O=een nieuwe koppeling|G=als deze niet werkt.
I will send a new link if this one does not work.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Offer a replacement link if needed.
Stuur is present with a conditional future meaning. Als deze niet werkt ends in werkt; deze refers to the current link, not the user.
Who is participating on behalf of support?
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Ask who represents support on the call.
Wie is the question subject of neemt. Deelnemen splits as neemt ... deel; namens de ondersteuning means on behalf of support.
S=Het doel van het gesprek|V=is|C=de volgende stap afspreken.
The purpose of the call is to agree the next step.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. State the call's purpose.
Het doel is the singular head of the subject with is. De volgende stap afspreken is an infinitive phrase naming the purpose, not a finite verb or direct object of is.
I share the current manual with the support team.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Name the document and its recipients.
Deel is the ik-form of delen. De huidige handleiding is what is shared and met het ondersteuningsteam identifies the recipients.
Which version is the latest approved version?
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Ask for the approved version rather than merely the newest draft.
Welke versie is the question subject of is. De laatste goedgekeurde versie is a complement; latest approved need not be the newest unapproved draft.
MOD=Kun|S=je|O=de koppeling|PP=in plaats van een kopie|I=sturen?
Can you send the link instead of a copy?
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Request a link to avoid separate copies.
Kun takes bare infinitive sturen. In plaats van een kopie specifies a link instead of a separate copy, rather than adding another copy.
The shared link does not grant new permissions.
You are sending an ordinary document link that uses existing permissions. Explain that this shared link grants no new rights.
Geeft agrees with de gedeelde koppeling. Geen nieuwe rechten limits this particular link's effect; links in other configurations may grant permissions.
We have clearly marked the draft version.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Report the draft label.
Hebben gemarkeerd is perfect. Duidelijk describes how the draft was marked; a draft label is not approval of the content.
The comments are next to the relevant paragraph.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Locate comments in the document.
Staan is plural with de opmerkingen. Naast de betreffende alinea locates the comments next to the relevant paragraph.
S=Ik|V=controleer|G=of alle ontvangers het document kunnen openen.
I check whether all recipients can open the document.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Describe an access check for recipients.
Of introduces whether, with plural alle ontvangers and final kunnen openen. Checking ability to open the document does not itself report a successful result.
This document must not be shared externally.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. State the sharing restriction.
Mag niet expresses prohibition, with passive gedeeld worden. Dit document receives the sharing action; extern limits the restriction to external sharing.
Where do we keep the final version?
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Ask for the authoritative storage location.
Waar asks storage location, followed by bewaren we. De definitieve versie is the object to keep; the question seeks the authoritative copy.
I have described the adjustments in the change overview.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Report where changes are explained.
Heb beschreven is perfect of beschrijven, with no ge- after be-. In het wijzigingsoverzicht locates the written description of the adjustments.
I have received your message, but have not read it yet.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Acknowledge receipt without claiming to have read it.
Heb governs both ontvangen and gelezen. Maar nog niet gelezen denies reading so far while affirming receipt of the same message.
A read receipt is not agreement.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Distinguish reading from consent.
Een leesbevestiging is singular with is. Geen akkoord is a complement: a read receipt does not count as agreement.
Can you summarise the agreement in your own words?
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Check understanding through a summary.
Kun takes joined infinitive samenvatten. In je eigen woorden requests a summary to check understanding, rather than merely confirming receipt.
I have read the instruction, but the last step is unclear.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Distinguish reading from full understanding.
Heb gelezen is perfect in the first clause. Maar introduces a new main clause with singular de laatste stap and finite is; reading has not made that last step clear.
S=Ik|V=begrijp|G=dat de controle vóór de wijziging komt.
I understand that the check comes before the change.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Confirm your understanding of the sequence.
Dat introduces the understood content and ends in komt. Vóór places the check before the change, not merely on the same day.
Is it clear who calls the user?
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Check understanding of call ownership.
Is precedes subject het in the yes/no question. Wie is the embedded subject of belt; de gebruiker is the person called, not the caller.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Limit what the confirmation proves.
Bevestigt agrees with de ontvanger. Alleen limits the confirmation to receipt; it does not assert reading, understanding or consent.
We still need to clarify the meaning.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. State that understanding remains unresolved.
Moeten takes infinitive verduidelijken. Nog says clarification of the meaning remains necessary, rather than already completed.
I do not agree to execution yet.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Withhold agreement despite acknowledging the message.
Akkoord gaan met means agree to or accept. Nog niet withholds agreement so far; met de uitvoering names carrying out the action, not receiving the message.
I check whether we mean the same deadline.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Check a possible deadline misunderstanding.
Of introduces whether and ends in plural bedoelen with we. Dezelfde deadline checks a shared intended date rather than simply acknowledging a message.
Can you answer this question before three o'clock?
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Request a reply before three.
Kun takes infinitive antwoorden with op deze vraag. Voor drie uur is the reply deadline; before three is the scenario's intended reading.
Kun je voor drie uur deze vraag beantwoorden?
Can you answer this question before three o'clock?
Beantwoorden takes a direct question object, whereas antwoorden uses op. Kun je retains the same informal request and deadline voor drie uur. No completed response is claimed.
I only need confirmation of the date.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Limit the requested response.
Alleen limits the requirement to confirmation of the date. Heb ... nodig means need; the sentence does not request a full report.
IM=Laat|IO=mij|I=weten|G=als je meer tijd nodig hebt.
Let me know if you need more time.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Invite the colleague to flag a response delay.
Laat mij weten is an instruction to notify the speaker; weten remains infinitive. Als introduces the condition and ends in hebt, with meer tijd as what is needed.
A full report is not needed for this question.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Clarify the limited response scope.
Een volledig verslag is the singular subject of is. Voor deze vraag gives scope, not a time deadline; niet nodig means unnecessary, not forbidden.
When can I expect your response?
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Ask for an expected response time.
Wanneer asks expected response time. Kan is a modal followed by bare infinitive verwachten; je reactie is the response expected by ik.
S=De reactie|V=helpt|O=ons|TE=om de planning vast te leggen.
The response helps us finalise the plan.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Explain why the reply is needed.
Helpt takes direct object ons for the people helped. Om de planning vast te leggen names the action enabled; separable vastleggen places te between vast and leggen.
Will you put the missing data in the same ticket?
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Request the reply in the existing record.
Wil je requests willingness and takes bare infinitive zetten. In hetzelfde ticket specifies the existing record for the missing data.
I have numbered the question for clarity.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Explain the numbered question.
Heb genummerd is perfect of nummeren. Voor de duidelijkheid gives purpose, not time; the speaker has numbered the question to identify it clearly.
G=Als je niet de juiste contactpersoon bent,|IM=verwijs|O=me|T=dan|PART=door.
If you are not the right contact person, please refer me on.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Ask to be directed to the correct person.
The als-clause ends in bent. Verwijs ... door is a separable imperative with understood je; me is the person to refer to the right contact.
F=Er|V=is|T=nog|S=geen antwoord op de tweede vraag.
There is no answer to the second question yet.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Identify the unanswered question.
Er introduces the absent answer; geen antwoord is singular with is. Nog means yet; op de tweede vraag specifies which question remains unanswered.
Tomorrow I work from home and can be reached through chat.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Give tomorrow's work location and contact channel.
Werk and ben share subject ik across en. Morgen locates the work; van thuis uit is Belgian from home, while via de chat gives the contact channel.
Who is the contact person during my break?
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Arrange cover during your break.
Wie is the question subject of is. Het aanspreekpunt is the designated contact role; tijdens mijn pauze limits the period of cover.
We can track progress in the shared overview.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Propose a shared progress record.
Kunnen takes joined infinitive bijhouden. De voortgang is tracked in the shared overview, rather than the overview being the person responsible.
S=Mijn status|V=betekent|NEG=niet|G=dat ik onmiddellijk kan reageren.
My status does not mean I can respond immediately.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Clarify what your online status does not promise.
Niet denies an inference from online status. The dat-clause ends in kan reageren; onmiddellijk is the response speed that status does not guarantee.
For urgent questions, you call the colleague on duty.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Give the urgent contact route.
Voor dringende vragen gives the reason for calling. Fronting it gives bel je without added -t after the stem; de dienstdoende collega is the person called.
Je belt voor dringende vragen de dienstdoende collega.
For urgent questions, you call the colleague on duty.

I have put my availability in the calendar.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Report where colleagues can find your availability.
Heb gezet is perfect with the regular participle gezet. Mijn bereikbaarheid means when I can be contacted here; in de agenda locates that information.
In de agenda heb ik mijn bereikbaarheid gezet.
I have put my availability in the calendar.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
Can you report your absence in advance?
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Request advance absence notification.
Kun takes bare infinitive melden. Vooraf means in advance; je afwezigheid is what must be reported, not an instruction to be absent.
S=We|V=spreken|PART=af|G=welke vragen via de chat gaan.
We agree which questions go through chat.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Define the chat channel's scope.
Afspreken splits as spreken ... af in the main clause. Welke vragen is the embedded plural subject of gaan; via de chat names their agreed channel.
Responsibility remains clearly divided even when working remotely.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. State that remote work retains explicit ownership.
Blijft agrees with de verantwoordelijkheid. Duidelijk verdeeld describes the continuing allocation, and ook op afstand includes remote working in that claim.
G=Als ik niet bereikbaar ben,|V=neemt|S=mijn collega|O=de opvolging|PART=over.
If I am unreachable, my colleague takes over follow-up.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Specify backup ownership.
The als-clause ends in ben. Main overnemen splits as neemt ... over, with mijn collega taking responsibility for follow-up if the speaker cannot be reached.
